hero.oneLiner: The deck positions B L Kashyap and Sons as a pan-India construction/EPC contractor with a 255+ project, ~140 million sq ft delivery record, a Rs 4,712 Cr order book and a completed financial turnaround built on sharply reduced fund-based debt.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Presented as a technology-driven, 'Digitized' contractor with integrated in-house MEP, ERP, drone and AI integration, and a proven execution track record on quality, safety and on-time delivery.
- Pan-India presence with offices in NCR and Bengaluru; the deck claims a balanced portfolio across private and public sector clients with repeat business from marquee clients across sectors.
- Deck frames the company as having achieved a 'Financial turnaround with sustained growth' and describes leadership (Vinod Kashyap - Chairman, Vineet Kashyap - MD, Viekram Kashyap - Jt MD) as bringing 'century of collective experience'.
- Positions itself in data centres, stating it has 'Delivered 2 data centers; positioned to scale this portfolio further' (landmark projects cited include Sattva-Molex Data Center, Bangalore and DLF Data Center, Noida).

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Fund-based debt reduced from Rs 700 Cr in 2014 to Rs 270 Cr in 2025, with only a cash credit facility remaining.
- Strategic priority of monetization of non-core assets to strengthen the balance sheet by FY27.
- Capex intent for FY27 is modest at Rs 65 Cr, directed at innovation, upskilling and fixed assets.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Exceptional item] The deck footnotes a Q4 FY25-26 exceptional loss of Rs 37.82 Cr comprising Rs 20 Crore payable towards the Right of Recompense (ROR) and Rs 17.82 Crore write-off of Contract Assets pursuant to an arbitration settlement.
- [Sectoral mix] The 'Sectoral Mix' slide shows only two figures, 54.35% and 45.65%, with no legend surviving extraction - the split cannot be attributed to any category and is not asserted here.
